correctness.rationale: For any finite nonempty poset, an upset U intersects upset A precisely when maximal traces U∩Max(W) and A∩Max(W) intersect, via extension to a maximal point. Thus within a fixed maximal trace an inclusion-smaller box neighbourhood dominates support/hitting, giving minimal trace-class representatives; box necessity follows by supports U and singleton-maximal upset tests using ≤width(W) instances. For universal diamond, inclusion-LARGER same-trace neighbourhoods dominate counterexamples; the test with scope Max(W) minus the trace of U and instance complements of principal downsets of minimal generators of U recovers existence of same-trace supersets and so maximal signature; |Min(U)|≤width(W). Depth-one variable valuations and induction give the exact same-poset all-formula iff. An antichain gives faithful complete recovery, while nonmaximal points yield distinct constant persistent indistinguishable families; an antichain on w elements realizes sharp arity w. On a chain, choices of empty upset and one extremal nonempty upset yield 2(n+1) independent box and diamond signatures and 4(n+1)^2 classes of constant assignments. Independently brute-forced both semantic clauses for ALL neighbourhood families of chain3/chain4, fork3, antichain3 and all upsets arguments of arity≤width: equivalence classes agree exactly with signatures (8,10,24,256 signatures per modality respectively). Finite checks supplement general poset proof.
